anchors.prompt: Same kitchen as the input photo, now he stands at the kitchen sink by the window on the left side: on the counter beside the sink a small white bowl, a glass sugar jar with fine white sugar, a tablespoon, the small dark amber dropper bottle, a tube of hand cream and a folded hand towel. The book and the aloe are gone. Waist-up, from about two meters, daylight from the window, he looks at the viewer.

EXTREME CLOSE-UP: a small white bowl with two spoonfuls of fine white sugar on the counter; his hand pours a tablespoon of golden oil over it. Only hands, no face —  Same place, same light and same objects as the first image, but the camera is now VERY CLOSE: this detail fills the whole frame.
Same close-up: the spoon has mixed the sugar and oil into a grainy glistening paste in the bowl.
Same place, same framing and same light: he holds the small bowl of sugar paste, looking at the viewer.
Same place, same framing and same light: he rubs the sugar paste on the back of his hand above the sink.

EXTREME CLOSE-UP of his HANDS ONLY above the sink: grainy sugar paste on the back of his left hand, right fingertips starting small circles. No face —  Same place, same light and same objects as the first image, but the camera is now VERY CLOSE: this detail fills the whole frame.
Same close-up: the paste spread over the back of the hand, the fingers moving around the knuckles.
Same place, same framing and same light: he holds his hands over the sink, looking at the viewer.
Same place, same framing and same light: he rubs hand cream between his hands.

EXTREME CLOSE-UP of his HANDS ONLY: white hand cream between his fingers and on the knuckles. No face —  Same place, same light and same objects as the first image, but the camera is now VERY CLOSE: this detail fills the whole frame.
Same close-up: the cream almost absorbed, the skin of the hands soft and moist.
Same place, same framing and same light: he shows his hands to the camera, satisfied.
Same place, same framing and same light: he holds the empty bowl, finger raised.
Same place, same framing and same light: he massages his cuticles, looking at the viewer.
Same place, same framing and same light: he holds his hand up with a serious, caring face.
Same kitchen: he sits at the small round wooden table near the window, looking at the viewer.

clips.text: Dos cucharadas de azúcar fina, una cucharada de aceite. Lo mezclas hasta que quede una pasta, así, granulada.
clips.action: EXTREME CLOSE-UP of the HANDS ONLY: a tablespoon of golden oil is poured over fine sugar in a small white bowl and stirred into a grainy paste.

clips.text: Con las manos secas, lo pasas por el dorso uno o dos minutos, en circulitos suaves. Suave, que la piel de las manos es más fina que la de la cara.
clips.action: He scoops a little paste with his fingers and rubs it on the back of his other hand in small gentle circles.

clips.text: Así. Y sin apretar sobre los nudillos, sobre todo si te duelen las articulaciones.
clips.action: EXTREME CLOSE-UP of the HANDS ONLY above the sink: fingertips make small circles with the grainy paste on the back of the hand, avoiding the knuckles.

clips.text: Enjuagas con agua tibia, secas con toquecitos, y enseguida crema de manos. Dos veces por semana, no más; todos los días irrita.
clips.action: He rinses his hands under the lukewarm tap, pats them dry with the towel, and squeezes hand cream onto one hand.

clips.text: La crema, bien metida entre los dedos y en los nudillos. Ahí es donde la piel se agrieta primero.
clips.action: EXTREME CLOSE-UP of the HANDS ONLY: hand cream is rubbed between the fingers and over the knuckles until absorbed.

clips.text: Y se prepara al momento, cada vez. No lo guardes mezclado, que el azúcar se humedece y se echa a perder.
clips.action: He shows the empty small bowl and wags a finger.

clips.text: ¿Y el aceite de laurel en las manos? Perfecto. De noche, después de lavar los platos, dos o tres gotas en el dorso y en las cutículas.
clips.action: He puts two drops from the amber dropper on the back of his hands and rubs them into his cuticles.

clips.text: Y una cosa seria: si una mancha cambia de color, crece rápido, se levanta o sangra, eso no es para aceite. Eso es para el dermatólogo, sin demora.
clips.action: He looks at the camera very seriously and points at a small spot on the back of his hand.

clips.text: Ahora, el colágeno. Porque el título lo dice, y te lo debo explicar bien, sin cuentos. Siéntate conmigo un momento.
clips.action: He dries his hands, pulls out a chair at the small round kitchen table near the window and sits down, inviting the viewer.
